messages.subject: Are any demos showing interactive zooming/panning of ggvis plots available yet?
parts:
I am completely new to ggvis, but would like to start using it for this functionality (like what the gadfly demos show):

https://github.com/rstudio/ggvis/issues/143

According to the ggvis 0.3 news, "Reactive expressions can be used for scale domains".

I'm learning ggvis from scratch right now, so maybe what I'm asking is trivial to do (I don't know), but I figure it doesn't hurt to see if there are any examples up and running which I can jump straight to?  I've been unsuccessfully searching the net for an example.

Or if anyone can provide a simple working example?

Thanks in advance...
